reviews.text: My mom needed her porch replaced and once I called, Tom was out quickly to give an estimate. He had her pick out the color and the porch turned out amazing!!
reviews.author: Julie H.

reviews.text: I highly recommend Tom and Derrick for any home construction project. They built a deck extension on our side porch as well as other projects around our home like drywall, concrete repair, and an entry door.
reviews.author: Nicole D.

reviews.text: Great to do business with! There was a weather related problem and these people stepped up to the plate immediately so no further damage would be done! Both Tom and Derek did an excellent job! Could not have asked for more!
reviews.author: Gloria K.
